items.title: New Unpatched Windows 0-Day FastUnlock Lets Someone Holding a Locked PC Run Programs on It
items.snippet: A newly disclosed unpatched zero-day technique called FastUnlock lets someone with physical access to a locked Windows computer start programs without signing in. Whoever uses it gets only a limited account, not administrator control of the machine. The method was posted yesterday by a researcher who uses the handles MSNightmare and Nightmare Eclipse, and the endpoint-security firm ThreatLocker
items.summary: An unpatched Windows zero-day called FastUnlock lets individuals with physical access to a locked PC run programs under a limited account. It affects Windows users who leave their locked machines unattended. No fix yet: watch for a patch.

items.title: Linux KVM Flaw CVE-2026-99312 Lets Guest VMs Access Host Memory on AMD Hosts
items.snippet: A flaw in KVM, the hypervisor built into the Linux kernel, let researchers read about 127 GB of a cloud server's memory from inside a virtual machine of their own on DigitalOcean. On a shared server, that memory can include other customers' virtual machines. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-99312, affects only hosts with AMD processors and nested virtualization enabled. Fixed kernels shipped
items.summary: A vulnerability in Linux KVM tracked as CVE-2026-99312 allows guest VMs on AMD hosts to access host memory. Review cloud infrastructure configurations and apply host kernel patches.

Anyone with component management access in the source Storyblok space, not server access, can plant a malicious component name that c…

items.title: js-toml allows uncontrolled recursion in `load()` leading `RangeError` (stack exhaustion) on deeply nested input
items.snippet: `load()` parses untrusted TOML using a recursive-descent parser (Chevrotain) and a recursive tree-walking interpreter. Neither the parser nor the interpreter enforces a maximum nesting / key depth. A small, attacker-controlled document with deep nesting (arrays, inline tables) or a long dotted key drives recursion past the V8 call-stack limit, and `load()` throws an uncaught `RangeError: Maximum…
items.summary: js-toml suffers from uncontrolled recursion in load() leading to RangeError stack exhaustion on deeply nested input, affecting Node.js projects parsing untrusted TOML. Upgrade js-toml to 1.1.3 or later.

items.title: aMQTT: Denial of Service (DoS) via Memory Leak in Unmanaged QoS 2 Session Handshakes
items.snippet: `amqtt` is vulnerable to a remote denial of service caused by incomplete MQTT QoS 2 transactions remaining allocated after the associated client disconnects. MQTT QoS 2 uses a four-step handshake to provide exactly-once delivery. If a client begins a QoS 2 transaction but disconnects before the handshake completes, `amqtt` retains the associated transaction state and packet identifier without an…
items.summary: aMQTT has a denial of service vulnerability via a memory leak in unmanaged QoS 2 session handshakes, affecting Python MQTT broker deployments. Upgrade amqtt to 0.12.1 or later.

A single client can freeze the entire broker by sending one specially crafted `SUBSCRIBE` packet followed by one `PUBLISH` packet. The vulnerability is caused by two defects: 1. `add_subscription()` validates the placement of the single-le…
items.summary: aMQTT is vulnerable to remote denial of service via inefficient regex complexity and improper topic-filter validation, affecting Python MQTT services. Upgrade amqtt to 0.11.4 or later.

The lack of input validation and error handl…
items.summary: Aedes suffers from an uncaught exception and uncontrolled resource consumption leading to remote Denial of Service. Developers using the Aedes MQTT broker are affected. Upgrade aedes to 1.1.1 or later.

Affected configuration (important): on 5.7.9 the default search temp…
items.summary: Contao core-bundle contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in frontend search results due to unescaped legacy variables. Developers maintaining Contao sites are affected. Upgrade contao/core-bundle to 5.3.50, 5.7.12 or later.

That voter supports only the `modules` field and the literal value `tpl_editor`. The equally RCE-capable `theme_import` capability li…
items.summary: Contao core-bundle permits non-admin users to self-grant permissions that implicitly make them administrators via the template editor. Developers using Contao are affected. Upgrade contao/core-bundle to 5.3.50, 5.7.12 or later.

items.summary: Contao core-bundle exhibits improper access control in the CSV import wizard allowing record overwrites. Developers maintaining Contao applications are affected. Upgrade contao/core-bundle to 5.3.50, 5.7.12 or later.

The newsletter custom key-actions are dispatched directly by `Backend::getBackendModule()` (B…
items.summary: Contao newsletter-bundle allows custom actions to bypass channel-scoped authorization checks. Developers using Contao newsletter features are affected. Upgrade contao/newsletter-bundle to 5.3.50, 5.7.12 or later.

items.title: wcmatch: Polynomial-time ReDoS when matching untrusted names against multi-star patterns (default flags)
items.snippet: With default flags, a pattern that contains several `*` wildcards takes polynomial time, O(n^k) for k stars, to reject a crafted file name. The pattern is an ordinary developer constant such as `*_*_*_*_*.csv`; only the string being matched comes from the attacker. A 255-byte file name (the maximum on common filesystems) takes 73 s with `fnmatch.fnmatch()` and 86 s with `glob.globmatch()`. The st…
items.summary: Wcmatch is vulnerable to polynomial-time ReDoS when matching untrusted names against multi-star patterns. Python developers using wcmatch for file matching are affected. Upgrade wcmatch to 11.2 or later.

In the measurements below, a 240 KB HTML document produces about 1 billion characters and uses about 1 GB of memory. `table_end_handler()` (`model/tag/table_tag.py`) writes the rendered table into the parent element with `HtmlElement.write_verbatim_te…
items.summary: Inscriptis suffers from quadratic memory growth when parsing sibling table elements in get_text(). Python developers parsing HTML with inscriptis are affected. Upgrade inscriptis to 2.7.6 or later.

items.title: svglib: Exponential resource consumption via nested <use> references in svg2rlg

A group containing N ` ` elements that point to another such group multiplies the work by N per nesting level, so an SVG of about 1.4 KB makes svglib clone and render over 100,000 nodes, taking tens of seconds of CPU time and hundreds of MiB of memory. Each…
items.summary: Svglib allows exponential resource consumption via nested use references in svg2rlg. Python developers converting SVG files using svglib are affected. Upgrade svglib to 2.3.1 or later.
